items.summary: The Karnataka government’s demand for transparency from the Rashtriya Swayamsevak Sangh (RSS) has triggered a fresh war of words between Home Minister Priyank Kharge and BJP leader BL Santhosh. Priyank Kharge on Sunday, August 16, questioned the legal status of the RSS after Santhosh said the organisation did not need formal registration to establish its existence. A day earlier, Santhosh, the BJP’s national general secretary (Organisation), made the remarks at an ‘Akhand Bharat Sankalp Day’ programme organised by the Hindu Jagarana Vedike in Bengaluru. “At that time too, the RSS was not registered, and it is not registered even today. Registration does not determine its existence; it is an organisation working through the trust of millions of people,” Santhosh said. He also claimed that the RSS had stood by Hindus during Partition. His remarks came amid Priyank’s repeated demands that the organisation establish its legal identity and disclose details about its finances.
